}}'''Jonai''' was a [[Da'shain]] [[Aiel]] lived during the [[Breaking|Breaking of the World]].{{ref/book|c|Jonai}} His story is learned from Rand's [[Visions of Rhuidean|visions]] in the ter'angreal of Rhuidean.

{{Ancestry/Rand}}

==History==
He was the son of [[Coumin]], who abandoned the [[Way of the Leaf]]. He was married to [[Alnora]] and father of [[Willim]], [[Adan]], and [[Esole]].

At the time within Rand's Vision, Jonai was 63 years old, and still considered in the prime of his life. He claims to feel old, though that is likely due to living through the beginning of the Breaking of the World and being required to do work he was never trained for.

In his childhood, Jonai was befriended by [[Someshta]], and once rode on his shoulders. During the early days of the Breaking, he was present in [[Paaran Disen]] before it's destruction. There, he was charged by [[Solinda]] Sedai to take the Aiel to safety along with a number of [[Chora]] tree cuttings and ''[[angreal]]'', ''[[sa'angreal]]'', and ''[[ter'angreal]]''.

Many years later, he was present when the Aiel encountered a group of [[Ogier]] and learned of the beginnings of the [[Longing]]. At this point Jonai suffered a heart attack and died, instructing Adan to keep the Covenant with his last breath. Jonai was an ancestor of [[Rand]].{{ref/book|4|26}}
